# Bot Overview

# What is Bot?

A bot in SeaTalk Open Platform (SOP) is a program that acts as a user within the SeaTalk messaging platform. It can interact with users in an 1-on-1 or a group chat. Bots can be used for various purposes, such as automation, task execution, addressing FAQs, etc.

# What Bot can do?

Bots in SeaTalk Open Platform (SOP) have a range of capabilities. To simplify, there are two concept of functionality that Bot can do:

1. **Receive Interactions:**receiving messages from user, added to a group chat, mentioned in a group chat, etc.
2. **Initiate Actions**: sending message to a user, sending message and tag user in a group chat, etc.

For every single interaction received by the bot, your server will receive an[Event Callback](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/server-apis-event-callback). On the other hand, every single action can be triggered through an[API](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/Understanding-Bot-Capabilities)call to SOP. See the diagram below.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

1. **SeaTalk App:**mobile or web application where**User** can interact with each other, join group chats, and perform various work-related tasks.
2. **SeaTalk Open Platform (SOP):** development platform that allows developers to create custom applications (including Bot) and services that integrate with the SeaTalk. The SOP provides the necessary tools and capabilities to create, configure, and manage bots on SeaTalk.
3. **Bot**: can be developed and integrated into the SeaTalk platform using the features and APIs provided by the SOP**,**where business logic of the bot is resided on the "**Your Server**"**.**

# What's Next?

Congratulations, now you're one step closer to building your bot. If you're ready, head straight to the "Getting Started" page to build your first bot!
